Storage readiness has watchdogs and clears rejected cached promises. Bootstrap awaits the actual UtilsPure storage adapter and vendors before local hydration; failure publishes disabled storage before loaded state, supports explicit retry/reconnect, coalesces in-flight attempts and suppresses updates after unmount. Existing 8-test suite retained unchanged.

Canvas reload reads workspace_recovery/store_v1, handles vault lock, preserves unsupported versions, offers legacy migration, and marks a failed check non-authoritative with error mode. A valid nonempty store presents recovery choice; empty History alone is not proof of absent stored data. Full recovery-dialog restore and bridge approval were not exercised in this new suite.

Canvas autosave gates student/mutation/locked-vault runs, saves with queue:false, waits for result containing the owned workspace before saved status, reports rejected-save errors, clears pending count, and checks run token/current workspace when publishing saved or error. Actual effect tested with delayed/rejected bridge transactions and interrupted ownership.

Vault repository defaults queue to false, supports absent/exact-legacy/revision read tokens, awaits storage CAS, and accepts only applied:true as a successful mutation. Actual repository tested with controlled commit and fresh-instance readback.
